Service

Feral Animal Management

Licensed, insured feral animal control programs across the Northern Territory.

Feral animals damage infrastructure, degrade habitat and create safety risks on properties and project sites. We deliver licensed, insured feral animal management programs tailored to your land, your objectives and your obligations.

What’s included

  • Assessment of feral animal activity, impacts and risks on your site
  • A management program matched to your objectives and regulations
  • Licensed control activities carried out to the relevant codes of practice
  • Monitoring to measure results over time
  • Reporting for landholders, managers and agencies

When you need it

Pastoral, conservation and Indigenous land managers

Mine sites, camps and infrastructure corridors

Government agencies and councils

Properties where feral animals threaten people, stock or assets

How it works

Assess

Site visit, habitat review and a clear read of the wildlife risk.

Plan

SOPs and SWMS written for your site, your crew and your permits.

Control

Overwatch, spotter catchers or capture — matched to the risk.

Brief

Toolbox talks and training so crews stay croc-wise.

[CONFIRM THE SPECIES YOU MANAGE — e.g. pigs, buffalo, cattle, cats, dogs]

Feral animal management is delivered across the Northern Territory.

Are programs humane?

Yes. Programs are carried out by licensed operators in line with the relevant codes of practice for humane control.
